# Complete Routing245 source bisimulation: production plan

The pilot has actually passed seven finite checks: initial segment and entries0,90,103,329,791,3012. Its complete certificate remains immutable. This production directory contains two uncompiled units, Data and Chunk000, and one frozen generator for the later independent chunks and final assembly. No new guard or compiler was run here.

The successful parent is `/tmp/zfc-routing245-lean/source-bisim-pilot/run1/verification.json`, SHA `4598ab1e2160d49e8774e0f71cf883b4766198342cdb088c6f6e27b630fa174f`, with fresh object `da87fcdecd9ade0ce3bc407b18da7ed013b12548690c57ef54cb250da77d1380`. Its ordinary source/audit times were9.9705965/0.2443582 seconds. These measurements do not establish a32-entry block's time.

## Data identity without copied entries

`BisimRouting245Data` imports the passed Pilot module. Its `cert` is exactly the public `BisimRouting245Pilot.cert`; `cert_eq` is reflexivity. Ninety-five public `chunkNNN` definitions are structural left/right projections of that public certificate. The helper projections are local to Data; no mangled or private Pilot identifier is mentioned.

`assembly` uses the original balanced top-tree shape and left-subtree sizes. `cert_decomposition : cert = assembly` is proved by reflexivity, making every projected block part of the actual full certificate. The fallback `.empty` cases in the total projection helpers are harmless only because this identity is required; a wrong projection cannot be accepted merely because allC on empty is true.

`allC_decomposition (f : Entry → Bool)` rewrites the full allC into an explicitly balanced Boolean conjunction of the95 block allC expressions. Its proof is generic structural equality, not certificate evaluation. The final module will use this equation and opaque chunk results, avoiding unfolding all3,013 entry checks again. `initial_ok` reuses the exact passed initial-segment result.

Data has four named probes and five typed callers. The imported DFS has eight project providers (the previous seven plus Pilot) and Init. All were rehashed from the exact Pilot record; this does not build or distribute historical cached providers. No binary table or logical calibration imports are needed.

## Independent finite block units

For each i=0..94, `BisimRouting245ChunkNNN.checked` has the exact shape:

```lean
RMBisim.allC BisimRouting245Data.test BisimRouting245Data.chunkNNN = true
```

Here `test` is `entryOk ActualTree254.tree TreeRouting245.tree cert` with the *full* certificate. Every successor index is resolved in that full relation, never in the local block. The first94 chunks contain32 entries; the last contains5, totaling3,013. The audit has one named probe and two callers: the closed allC fact and an arbitrary-index `lookupC_all` consequence for that exact block.

Only Chunk000, indices[0,32), is emitted now. Data must pass first, then its exact successful source/object becomes the ninth project provider for each chunk. Root measures Chunk000 under the unchanged default proof limits and shared120-second source/audit cap with `-j1 -M4096`. The proposed direct `decide +kernel` is tested by that actual run; no performance success is assumed.

After the first block passes within the cap, the same generator can emit chunks001..094. Preserve `units-v1.json`; the production units manifest should be a separate successor pinning the exact successful Data record/object, all95 half-open intervals, unique module names and source/audit hashes. Data and Chunk000 bytes stay unchanged. A single reviewed guard policy and root-owned serial runner can process the remaining independent units, each with a new isolated cache/output directory, source pass and fresh-object capture before audit, before/after provider/input checks and its own120-second shared cap. Stop and retain evidence on a failure; no partial or failed module is a successful provider. Repetitive unit correctness can be checked by manifest/template equality and one focused independent generator/guard review.

There is no need for95 individually authored prose packets. The frozen generator includes a final-source template but does not emit it yet.
